form_analysis.feedback: Good aftercare for a gentle, hydrating AHA peel. Correctly positions it as an option for sensitive skin and highlights its unique moisturising benefits alongside exfoliation. Provides appropriate cautions despite its gentle nature.

form_data.introduction: This aftercare advice is for a lactic acid peel, an alpha-hydroxy acid (AHA) derived from milk. It is known for being gentler than glycolic acid while providing effective exfoliation and notable hydration. Ideal for dry, dehydrated, or sensitive skin types.

instructions.general_directive: Please follow the General Chemical Peel Principles. The notes below are specific to lactic acid peels.

sections.title: Immediate Post-Treatment Symptoms and Timeline
sections.content: You may feel a mild tingling that subsides quickly. Significant stinging is uncommon. Skin will have a healthy glow and may be slightly pink for 6-24 hours. Visible peeling is often minimal; you may experience only light, sandpaper-like flaking 2-3 days post-treatment. Your skin should feel supple, not tight.

sections.title: Specific Instructions
items: Hydration Boost: Lactic acid is a humectant. Support this by using a good moisturizer and drinking plenty of water to enhance the plumping effect.
Gentle Care: Even though it's gentle, avoid other exfoliants (physical or chemical) for 5-7 days.
Sun Sensitivity: As an AHA, it increases photosensitivity. Daily SPF 30+ use is mandatory for 1 week.
Sensitive Skin: This peel is often well-tolerated. However, if you have rosacea or extremely reactive skin, monitor for increased redness.

sections.title: Activity Restrictions
sections.content: Avoid strenuous exercise and heat for 24-48 hours as a precaution.

sections.title: Makeup
sections.content: You can typically apply makeup within a few hours, once the skin feels normal.

sections.title: General Side Effects and Results Assessment
items: Adverse reactions are rare. Contact your practitioner if you experience persistent redness, itching, or rash.
Results include improved hydration, smoother texture, and a brighter, more even tone. It's excellent for treating dullness.
A series of peels (every 2-4 weeks) will yield cumulative benefits for fine lines and hyperpigmentation.
Lactic acid is a good introductory peel for those new to chemical exfoliation.
